<thought>Using the most intense peak (m/z 262.099) as the [M+H]⁺ ion, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈261.09 Da. A formula that matches this mass, has only C, H, O, and gives an integer double‑bond equivalent is C₁₁H₁₈O₇ (exact mass 261.098 Da, DBE = 3). This best fits the observed spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H18O7</final_answer>
